messages.subject: Advice on the merits - Maybrook v Helmsworth
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

My advice on the merits and quantum is attached. In short: strong on liability (~75%), with the real risk being clause 14.2 and the lost-profit exclusion - I put defeating that at 55-60%. Central recovery estimate £750k-£950k plus interest and costs. I'd recommend a Part 36 offer around £820k once Penrith's report is finalised.

Harriet
